testimonials.title: Testimonials and logos
testimonials.intro: Testimonials come from real thank-you letters. A testimonial or logo goes public only when the organization's consent is confirmed, the admin has approved it, and it's published.

consent.label: تمت الموافقة على النشر
consent.hint: Tick this only when the organization agreed in writing to be shown (consent to publish).

approval.withdrawNote: Withdrawing also sets it back to draft, so it leaves the site at once.
approval.approvedDone: {name} is approved. An editor can publish it now.
approval.withdrawnDone: Approval withdrawn for {name}. It's a draft again and no longer on the site.
approval.failed: The approval couldn't be saved. Try again.

letter.heading: Source letter
letter.hint: The original thank-you letter. It's internal and never shown to visitors.
letter.openHint: Opens in a new tab through a link that expires after 60 seconds.

settings.title: Site settings
settings.intro: Contact details, social links and the CV. They show in the header, footer and contact page.
settings.whatsappHint: With the country code, such as +967712345678.
settings.socialHint: Up to {max} links. Each needs a name and an https link.
settings.cvVisible: Show the CV download on the site
settings.cvVisibleHint: Shown only when a CV file is uploaded.
settings.saved: Saved. The site shows the change now.
settings.cvFileHint: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB. Visitors can download it when it's shown.

errors.cantClear: This can't be left empty. Enter a new value.
